escalation_criteria._note: Which patient texts must reach a clinician, and how fast, is a clinical policy the partner's designated reviewer approves before any real patient. The prototype's criteria are code (EMERGENCY_RE, clinical intents, topics) and are shown here for review.
criteria: emergency wording (code list) → 911 text + emergency referral
clinical question / staff request → portal link (default) or opted-in queue
preparation question → approved text, no referral
documented-rationale question → quoted note, no referral

capabilities._note: V5-1: partner-granted operational capabilities. The engine DENIES messaging, booking, relay, queue and note import unless granted here; a missing block means nothing is granted. Synthetic partner grants all of them so the demo runs; tests revoke each.
